definitions.explanation: Describes an appearance that is both beautiful and well-balanced. Often used for people with refined, elegant features, or for things with a clean, polished beauty.

examples.japanese: {端麗|たんれい}な{顔立|かおだ}ちの{女性|じょせい}だ。
examples.english: She is a woman with graceful features.

examples.japanese: {容姿|ようし}{端麗|たんれい}な{俳優|はいゆう}が{話題|わだい}になった。
examples.english: A handsome actor became the talk of the town.

examples.japanese: この{日本酒|にほんしゅ}は{端麗|たんれい}な{味|あじ}わいで{飲|の}みやすい。
examples.english: This sake has a clean, refined flavor and is easy to drink.

notes: Most commonly appears in the four-character compound {容姿|ようし}{端麗|たんれい} (beautiful appearance, good-looking), which is a set phrase used in formal or literary contexts to describe someone's attractive appearance. Also used in sake terminology: {端麗|たんれい}{辛口|からくち} (clean and dry) describes sake with a crisp, refined flavor. A literary and somewhat formal word.
